races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
ECLAIRAGE is on a good mark if Colin Keane can settle her down and gets the vote to notch a fifth C&D success. Thriving 3-y-os Firewalker and Coincidental Glory seem sure to be in the mix.

  1. ECLAIRAGE (IRE)
  2. FIREWALKER
  3. COINCIDENTAL GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
RED GLORY is on a fair mark on the level judged on his Thurles second and is worth another chance with the step up to 2m likely to suit. Friday's winner Young Churchill can go well again if staying the longer trip, with Duke Otto another to consider after his recent hurdles victory.

  1. RED GLORY (IRE)
  2. YOUNG CHURCHILL (IRE)
  3. DUKE OTTO (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
SHARPE RATIO made a very promising debut when second over 6f here a fortnight ago, looking strong at the finish, and can go one better up in trip. His yard saddle 6 runners, with Irishamerican and Solar Palace appealing newcomers on paper.

  1. SHARPE RATIO (USA)
  2. IRISHAMERICAN (IRE)
  3. SOLAR PALACE

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
The unexposed SEDRO WOOLLEY was good value for his victory here last month, seeing off a next-time-out winner, and can follow up back over 1m after a 4 lb rise. The Bear Trap and Magna Gee Gee are a couple of the other more appealing types.

  1. SEDRO WOOLLEY (IRE)
  2. THE BEAR TRAP (IRE)
  3. MAGNA GEE GEE (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with multiple C&D scorer COMFORT LINE who rates the pick of the weights and is reunited with Adam Caffrey for the first time since going in at the Curragh in late summer. Desert Of The Sea wasn't seen to best effect over C&D last time and is next on the list ahead of another C&D winner, Chavajod.

  1. COMFORT LINE (IRE)
  2. DESERT OF THE SEA (IRE)
  3. CHAVAJOD

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Having dropped in the weights, GAVOO has found his level and on the back of a very encouraging third over C&D, he looks too well weighted to ignore. Art Gallery was behind the selection that day but is entitled to step up on that stable debut, with Leveraging also considered.

  1. GAVOO (IRE)
  2. ART GALLERY (IRE)
  3. LEVERAGING (IRE)

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Maiden
races.verdict:
LET'S SMASH IT has to prove his stamina for this far but is still the most persuasive option in a trappy-looking maiden. Support for Ossie's Lodge on his return to the track would look very significant, while Meet The Day could be a factor on debut.

  1. LET'S SMASH IT (IRE)
  2. OSSIE'S LODGE (IRE)
  3. MEET THE DAY (IRE)

races.name: Floodlit Fridays At Dundalk (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
GRANVILLE STREET continues in fine form and can resume winning ways back on polytrack for the first time since his 3-y-o days when he ran well twice here. Ozark Daze is interesting from a career-low mark, with Letiza another to consider.

  1. GRANVILLE STREET (IRE)
  2. OZARK DAZE
  3. LETIZA (IRE)

races.name: Octaga Security Systems Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A useful bumper performer, MOMENTS AWAY wasn't able to build on his hurdling debut effort dropped in trip at Newbury 20 days ago, but he remains capable of better now returned to further. He is fancied to open his account this time round, with North Gale looking the main danger as he goes up in distance, ahead of Teleleo.

  1. MOMENTS AWAY (IRE)
  2. NORTH GALE (IRE)
  3. TELELEO

races.name: Herefordshire Community Foundation Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Runner-up in a bumper at this course, LEGEND D'AIRY shaped as if he would be better for the experience on his first start over hurdles last month, so he could well leave that effort behind back at this venue. Dual bumper winner Saint Argente isn't taken lightly on hurdling debut, though, with Criminal also one to note.

  1. LEGEND D'AIRY (FR)
  2. SAINT ARGENTE (IRE)
  3. CRIMINAL

races.name: Castle Sychrov Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY has taken to chasing like a duck to water and can add a second success to his tally with further improvement on the cards. Prairie Queen finished 5 lengths behind the selection last time and she looks the biggest threat again in a reapplied tongue tie, with Monark Wood rounding off the shortlist now tackling the larger obstacles (chaser on looks).

  1. ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE)
  2. PRAIRIE QUEEN
  3. MONARK WOOD (FR)

races.name: Angel Cybersecurity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A trappy handicap and with that in mind a chance is taken on V POWER. A 3-time scorer on the Flat this year, he produced easily his best effort over hurdles when second behind a subsequent winner at Chepstow 2 starts back. He found things tougher under a big weight back there last time but this looks a bit easier and he could represent a spot of value. Cawthorne Cracker arrives in rude health and is feared most, ahead of stablemate Knighton and God of Fire.

  1. V POWER
  2. CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE)
  3. KNIGHTON

races.name: Cuban Pete Celebration Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MY BOBBY'S LASS had too much speed for her rivals when making it third time lucky over fences at Bangor last month and with further improvement on the cards, Mel Rowley's mare is fancied to shrug off a 9 lb rise and follow up. Law of Supply has found one too strong on his last 3 starts and he may have to settle for another silver medal, with Doctor Midas taken to fill out third.

  1. MY BOBBY'S LASS
  2. LAW OF SUPPLY (IRE)
  3. DOCTOR MIDAS (FR)

races.name: Hampden Agencies Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SAXONS PRIDE has offered encouragement when finishing third on both of her starts over hurdles so far, including over C&D on her return, and she can open her account with improvement to come now handicapping. The biggest threat could come from stablemate Ghost Dancing, while Guildhall Graduate is also considered on her handicap hurdle debut.

  1. SAXONS PRIDE
  2. GHOST DANCING
  3. GUILDHALL GRADUATE (IRE)

races.name: White Heron Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SLAVETOTHERHYTHM ticks plenty of the right boxes on paper and is taken to add to his yard's good bumper record at this track by making a winning start. Irish raider Move The Line requires close market scrutiny, with Mikindaguy another newcomer to note.

  1. SLAVETOTHERHYTHM (FR)
  2. MOVE THE LINE (IRE)
  3. MIKINDAGUY

races.name: Book Now For The BoyleSports Christmas Meeting Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
METS TA CEINTURE stands out a mile on her bumper form and is a straightforward choice to make a winning hurdling debut. Island Jetaway makes most appeal of the remainder.

  1. METS TA CEINTURE (FR)
  2. ISLAND JETAWAY (IRE)
  3. EROICO (IRE)

races.name: wetherbyracing.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and I HEARD A RUMOUR gets a confident vote to make light of a 10 lb rise in the weights for her comfortable Chepstow victory, with this longer trip also rating a plus for Dan Skelton's upwardly-mobile mare. Southwell runner-up Moveonbuy appeals as the one to chase her home ahead of Mr Ramoon and Masterminding.

  1. I HEARD A RUMOUR (IRE)
  2. MOVEONBUY
  3. MR RAMOON (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DEARKEITHANDKATY resumed progress sent chasing after 5 months off when successful at Carlisle (2½m) 5 weeks ago and with the return to further firmly in his favour, he looks to have plenty going for him on the back of a 5 lb rise. This is competitive, though, with Worcester eyecatcher In The Age worthy of note for the Skeltons. Slaney Opera and Jeteye are a pair arriving in red-hot form and also command plenty of respect.

  1. DEARKEITHANDKATY (FR)
  2. IN THE AGE (FR)
  3. SLANEY OPERA (IRE)

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This provides a good opportunity for KEFIR D'OUDAIRIES to make a winning handicap debut on the back of his facile win in a small-field novice at Warwick 2 weeks ago. Bertie's Ballet is respected with the longer trip likely to suit, with El Gavilan also a potential factor in reapplied headgear.

  1. KEFIR D'OUDAIRIES (FR)
  2. BERTIE'S BALLET
  3. EL GAVILAN (FR)

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
THEATRE TOM would've gone very close at Worcester if not for a late fall on his penultimate outing and perhaps wasn't ideally suited by the step up in trip there last time, so makes most appeal dropping back to this trip. Mandarb made great strides in 2 handicap starts last season and may not have finished improving, whilst Gentleman Bill is also respected after a solid second on his return.

  1. THEATRE TOM (IRE)
  2. MANDARB (FR)
  3. GENTLEMAN BILL (IRE)

races.name: Watch Racing TV In HD Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a really hot race but ALBIE LITTLEWOOD is fancied to complete the 4-timer having still been able to make a winning start over fences despite market weakness at Worcester last month. Smart Decision jumped well for a long way when a close second over C&D on his chasing bow, whilst Ninna Collina was 3-3 over hurdles last season and has the physique to make an even better chaser.

  1. ALBIE LITTLEWOOD (IRE)
  2. SMART DECISION
  3. NINNA COLLINA

races.name: Watch Race Replays At racingtv.com Mares' NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur)
races.verdict:
NORTHERN SINGER overcame a pace bias in good style at Chepstow on her Rules debut last month and looks capable of defying a penalty. Kirsty's Legacy is an interesting newcomer for a yard which also has plenty of success in this sphere, and would need taking very seriously if the subject of strong support. Go Jackie represents the same connections who sent out a tidy first-time-out bumper winner at Warwick last week and merits consideration, too.

  1. NORTHERN SINGER (IRE)
  2. KIRSTY'S LEGACY
  3. GO JACKIE

races.name: Racing TV EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
The market will no doubt prove informative with several of these making their debut, BET YOU CAN'T getting the vote to enhance what has been an excellent year for the Boughey/Loughnane combination. Jalapeno Gal and Spiders From Mars also look likely types on paper for Ed Walker.

  1. BET YOU CAN'T (IRE)
  2. JALAPENO GAL
  3. SPIDERS FROM MARS (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Making her third start, JAHAMI failed to keep straight under pressure when demoted to second at Wolverhampton last month, but she's in top hands and remains open to improvement as she gains further experience. She is taken to see off the challenge of Lady's Grace who has made the frame in her 3 races so far, with Sand Dance also considered.

  1. JAHAMI
  2. LADY'S GRACE
  3. SAND DANCE (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is a fairly late debut for HIGHEST PEAK but he couldn't be in better hands and given his pedigree, he could easily outclass these. Lean D'Aislingean will find this easier than the handicaps he's been running in of late, while Crown Knott, a former stablemate of the selection, may show more this time.

  1. HIGHEST PEAK (IRE)
  2. LEAN D'AISLINGEAN (IRE)
  3. CROWN KNOTT

races.name: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Nursery
races.verdict:
Preference is for ADMIRAL LEACH, who shaped as if he may come on for the run when finishing mid-field on nursery debut at Newcastle earlier this month. He's bred to be suited by this extra 1f and gets the vote ahead of Lopefernza, another with potential as she goes up in trip, while Angel of Heaven is one to note on her nursery bow.

  1. ADMIRAL LEACH (IRE)
  2. LOPEFERNZA
  3. ANGEL OF HEAVEN

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
MELODICAL showed improved form when getting up late over this C&D last month and she can go on to score again now that she's up and running. Next on the list is Aurelune who has placed on her last 3 starts and now gets an eye-catching jockey booking, ahead of Upsomdowns.

  1. MELODICAL
  2. AURELUNE (IRE)
  3. UPSOMDOWNS

races.name: Unibet Floodlit Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
Successful at the highest level last summer, EL CORDOBES hasn't had things go his way in only 3 outings this year, so he is taken to get back to winning ways as he returns to listed level. Amiloc also brings Group 1 form to the table having been runner-up in last season's Irish St Leger and could be the main danger, with Constitution Hill also considered back down in grade.

  1. EL CORDOBES (IRE)
  2. AMILOC
  3. CONSTITUTION HILL

races.name: Unibet London Middle Distance Series (Final) Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This series final can go the way of TRYFAN, who did well to get as close as he did when runner-up here 6 weeks ago. With the potential for plenty of pace in this race, he is fancied to reverse the placings with War Hawk from when the pair met last time, King's Code completing the shortlist as he bids to land this prize for a second year running.

  1. TRYFAN
  2. WAR HAWK (IRE)
  3. KING'S CODE

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
The return to this sort of trip will suit LUNELLA and unlike most of these, she has the scope to rate higher on what is just her second handicap start. Midnight Media can remain competitive, while Nottingham 1-2 Ghost Story and Glenna can also make their presence felt.

  1. LUNELLA (IRE)
  2. MIDNIGHT MEDIA
  3. GHOST STORY (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
Stall 11 could have been better but PHOENIX OF DREAMS is at the top of his game on all-weather at present so he may well overcome it under a penalty. Billy Mill is a reliable proposition at this venue, with Split Elevens completing the shortlist.

  1. PHOENIX OF DREAMS (IRE)
  2. BILLY MILL
  3. SPLIT ELEVENS

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but ALWAYS HAPPY shaped well when runner-up at Southwell after an absence last time and can go one better with this first attempt beyond 1m also looking a plus. The consistent Borjina heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Arbaawy, Triple Force and Tropical Sands also need factoring in.

  1. ALWAYS HAPPY (IRE)
  2. BORJINA
  3. ARBAAWY

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BLOWING UP A STORM shaped well on her debut for Richard Hughes when third at Kempton and can build on it for her new yard and get off the mark. Ed Walker's Starspangledbanner newcomer Sweet Pea could emerge as the main danger, although Persian Coast and Beautiful Force also enter calculations with better days ahead of them.

  1. BLOWING UP A STORM
  2. SWEET PEA
  3. PERSIAN COAST (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The market should reveal plenty but the vote goes to the Gosdens' Saxon Warrior newcomer ST EDMUND who is bred to be well above average and can thwart form pick Grinanbearit who could have to settle for runner-up spot again. Quavo, Plinian and Helvellyn are other debutants who could also come into the reckoning if the betting speaks in their favour.

  1. ST EDMUND (IRE)
  2. GRINANBEARIT (IRE)
  3. QUAVO (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty with chances but the Gosdens' lightly-raced LIGHTING THUNDER made a promising return from an absence when fourth on his recent handicap debut at Newmarket and gets the vote with more improvement very much on the cards from this son of Night Of Thunder. Lost Signal also looks to have better days ahead of him and is next on the list, while Canvas, Nepal and Rhoscolyn are all in the mix too.

  1. LIGHTING THUNDER
  2. LOST SIGNAL (IRE)
  3. CANVAS

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
MASSIMO BLUE has thrived for the switch to Dylan Cunha and is fancied to garner a fourth success for the yard on the back of an unlucky C&D second. Angel Love also arrives on the up and is feared most in her bid for a second C&D victory, while Itsatenfromlen and Dandy Magic can also play a prominent role.

  1. MASSIMO BLUE
  2. ANGEL LOVE
  3. ITSATENFROMLEN

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
YIMMNA advanced her form on her first foray into handicap company when a clear runner-up at Southwell and looks the way to go off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Filly Eilish has a career-high mark to overcome but scored in good style at Southwell last time and rates a big threat, while in-form duo Leopards Rock and Rapide Vega can also have a say in this competitive handicap.

  1. YIMMNA (FR)
  2. FILLY EILISH (IRE)
  3. LEOPARDS ROCK

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
A wide-open sprint handicap with the narrow vote in favour of KING'S CROWN. He needs to dispel a lesser effort here 3 weeks ago but tasted success twice from much higher marks over C&D last winter and this is his easiest assignment for some time. Dc Cogent is another to note on the back of a short break, with Woolridge and Shatin Venture completing the shortlist.

  1. KING'S CROWN (IRE)
  2. DC COGENT
  3. WOOLRIDGE

races.name: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A tricky race to assess so a chance is taken on TAKE THE A TRAIN. His very best efforts to date have come at this course and he ought to be sharper for his mid-field effort over further at Redcar a month ago. Multaneighttothree and Tomorrow Day are 2 of the likeliest dangers.

  1. TAKE THE A TRAIN
  2. MULTANEIGHTTOTHREE (IRE)
  3. TOMORROW DAY

races.name: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GRESSINGTON holds a significant class edge over most here on the pick of his form and with his latest C&D effort easily overlooked, he could be worth siding with from a career-low mark starting out for a shrewd stable. Joud is easily one of the least exposed and is a threat, with Coulsty Exchange and Sovereign Class next best.

  1. GRESSINGTON (IRE)
  2. JOUD
  3. COULSTY EXCHANGE (IRE)

races.name: Lucky Fish Cape Punters Cup On Sunday 29 November Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
MOSAIC WORLD edges it as the selection. Spurious could provide the main threat, while One Dawn also requires consideration.

  1. MOSAIC WORLD (SAF)
  2. SPURIOUS (SAF)
  3. ONE DAWN (SAF)

races.name: Join Race Your Dream Syndicate Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
RUNNING SHOES is the obvious call. John Coltrane is a big danger, while Masterofphotografy also requires respect.

  1. RUNNING SHOES (SAF)
  2. JOHN COLTRANE (SAF)
  3. MASTEROFPHOTOGRAFY (SAF)

races.name: Dress To Impress To Win R2000 At Lucky Fish Punters Cup Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
CRACKER looks to have marginally the best claims. Gunner Galactico is a sound alternative, while Shesheleza is another with place prospects too.

  1. CRACKER (SAF)
  2. GUNNER GALACTICO (SAF)
  3. SHESHELEZA (SAF)

races.name: Goodluck Live At Hollywoodbets Kenilworth 29 November Open Maiden (F & M)
races.verdict:
FINAL SAY has strong claims. Spirit Of Life is not one to underestimate, while Jane Austen can surely win a race soon.

  1. FINAL SAY (SAF)
  2. SPIRIT OF LIFE (SAF)
  3. JANE AUSTEN (SAF)

races.name: Race Coast Turf Club Members Get Free Entry To Lucky Fish Punters Cup Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN'S ANGEL edges it as the selection. Bart Nel also requires close scrutiny, while Mercury isn't out of it.

  1. CAPTAIN'S ANGEL (SAF)
  2. BART NEL (SAF)
  3. MERCURY (SAF)

races.name: Tickets R50 For Adults And Kids Free At Lucky Fish Punters Cup Foundation Stakes
races.verdict:
MIDWAY could take an open contest. Wehaveasituation is foremost among the dangers, while Gimme More Apache is another to consider.

  1. MIDWAY (SAF)
  2. WEHAVEASITUATION (SAF)
  3. GIMME MORE APACHE (SAF)

races.name: Prawn Festival Sunday 29 November At Hollywoodbets Kenilworth Conditions Plate
races.verdict:
VIVA'S LIBERTE has very good form claims down in class. Roland Garros can figure, while Wish List is another that could go well.

  1. VIVA'S LIBERTE (SAF)
  2. ROLAND GARROS (SAF)
  3. WISH LIST (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Fm 84 Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
JULIET OF VERONA is probably the best recommendation. Mystic Inferno is a big threat, while Merriment is another likely to be on the premises.

  1. JULIET OF VERONA (SAF)
  2. MYSTIC INFERNO (SAF)
  3. MERRIMENT (SAF)
